findings.text: checkSegment resets a running transcode from a detached goroutine writing t.startTime/t.segmentStart with no lock, while concurrent HLS requests read those fields under t.mu and t.start reads t.startTime outside the lock — a real data race (race tests pass only because the suite never exercises a concurrent reset).

FFmpeg subprocess errors fully swallowed: cmd.Stdout/Stderr = io.Discard, goroutine drops cmd.Wait() errors without logging, and the restart chain ignores every step (_ = os.ReadDir, _ = os.Remove, _ = t.generatePlaylist, _ = t.start) — a dead/crash-looping ffmpeg leaves sessions silently serving 404 segments with zero diagnosability.

Library settings errors silently fallback to defaults: '_ = h.db.QueryRowContext(... SELECT settings ...)' and '_ = json.Unmarshal(settingsRaw, &settings)' — any DB failure defaults markAsFinishedTimeRemaining to 10 and changes persisted values, no error surfaced.
Hand-rolled parseUA duplicated across feature packages instead of a leaf package — duplicates with unclear owner, behavior can drift.

Whole module routes through the hand-rolled Handle(...) bool chain + splitPath with parts[N] matching — the pattern ARCHITECTURE/AGENTS.md forbids adding; grandfathered legacy (Phase 5), but every route addition deepens the deviation.
loadBook silently swallows authors/series query errors (e == nil pattern) — DB failure yields a book response with empty authors/series; pervasive '_ = json.Unmarshal(...)' on stored JSON blobs.
Dead placeholder code: 'if meta, ok := chosen["metadata"]; ok { _ = meta }' does nothing; '_ = duration' discards a start() parameter.
N+1 duplicate per-session username lookups in a loop (errors ignored); updatedAt re-queried in a second round-trip when it could have been selected.

handleLocalSync non-all path: both nil-result and non-nil branches end in an identical sendOK; syncOneLocal collapses every error class into fixed strings like 'Media item not found' returned as HTTP 500.
h.localIDs maps play_local_ ids to UUIDs, never pruned or bounded; loadBook/loadPodcast use 12-13 pointer out-params with duplicated tags/genres/chapters normalization blocks.
